title: Freeing Yourself of Painful Emotional Sensations
fullTitle: Soul Snack #14: Freeing Yourself of Painful Emotional Sensations
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav addresses a powerful listener question about self-judgment and strong emotions.
Gary shares why emotions – both painful and joyful – are messengers from your soul and vital tools for your spiritual growth.
By acting consciously and choosing love over fear, you create authentic power and align your personality with your soul.
This Soul Snack reminds us that the path to spiritual transformation lies in the choices we make – especially when life feels painful.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: When a painful emotion arises, pause. Feel the physical sensations fully – whether it’s anger, jealousy, or resentment – and consciously choose not to react from fear. Instead, act from a loving part of your personality, such as patience or gratitude. This is where true growth begins.
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here.
